description: This file defines a Flutter widget called CuratedCarousel that displays a horizontal list of curated items, each presented as a card with a gradient background and optional close button overlay. It includes internal classes for individual cards and an overlay button, and references external models, themes, and Flutter widgets.

classes.name: _CuratedCard
classes.description: A widget that represents an individual curated content card with a gradient background, title, and optional overlay button.

classes.name: _CuratedOverlayXButton
classes.description: A widget that renders a dismiss button overlay with tooltip and semantics for accessibility.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CuratedCarousel, creating a horizontal list of curated items.

methods.name: _CuratedCard.build
methods.description: Builds the individual curated content card with decoration and optional overlay button.

methods.name: _CuratedOverlayXButton.build
methods.description: Builds the dismiss overlay button with tooltip and ink response.
